generic_guidance.q: What are the common reasons applications get rejected?
generic_guidance.a: Common rejection reasons (workflow guide): 1) incomplete documents -- a missing, invalid or expired Sale Deed, EC or ID, or documents not properly attested; 2) area mismatch -- the sale deed area differs from the survey records or the sub-division areas do not add up to the original; 3) encroachment found at the field visit, boundary disputes or unauthorised construction; 4) litigation flag -- an ongoing court case, disputed ownership or a stay order; 5) revenue arrears -- pending property tax or dues on the survey number; 6) invalid survey number -- it does not exist, belongs to another jurisdiction or is already sub-divided. After a rejection the applicant has 30 days to resubmit (up to 3 resubmissions). For why one file was rejected ask: why was [application number] rejected?
